notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a Wedding Ring.
You have a way to draw a card.
It is your turn.
description:
Draw a card.
The opponent's Wedding Ring triggers, causing them to draw a card.
Mind's Eye triggers, holding priority, activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a card, adding {B}.
Resolve the Mind's Eye trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
